notes: A client with one large landscape and a picture per step gets the page as measured; with fewer the opening is a plain dark band.
The moving headline over the quotes is the brand name (the data has no heading for quotes); without quotes and credentials the section is not made.
Titles from one word to twelve hold: the size steps from 187.5 px down so each half sits in one, two or three lines.
The reference's small fixed button at the lower left is not carried over: it covered text that passed under it (caught by tools/legible.mjs on three variants).
Control words (Menu, Close) come from a small list by language; no alt is shown as text.
needs (as written): steps.items with a picture each (the large cards), or place.spaces
needs (as written): one of: catalogue, faq, plans, team (the page's lower half)
drops (as written): steps.items[].k when the item has a title; team.groups[].t (people are shown in one run)
drops (as written): features.title / features.text and the items when a catalogue carries the same names (local1: the same ten)
drops (as written): a catalogue item's text when a step already shows the same words, and its picture when a step already shows it (local1: Kitchens, Staircases become plain rows)
drops (as written): place.spaces when they repeat the steps (hotel1: the same three)
drops (as written): links[].d; signin when hero.secondary exists; the outline button in the bar when there are more than five links
drops (as written): credentials[].img; logos without src; place.since, cuisine, price_range, takeaway
drops (as written): media.screens, media.phones, media.made
drops (as written): photographs beyond the slots (local1: 6 of 20, among them the directors' group picture; hotel1: 6 of 13 - room pictures the client's data has no words for)
drops (as written): on phones: the photograph of the dark half and the labels over quarter cards (as the reference)
motif (as written): the client's own photographs (media.made is never read)
